subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work/PB452.md LANDED 2026-09-09. FLOAT-NOT-A-NUMBER stores a canonical QUIET NaN with the sign GR34 names. The rule's implementor-defined PAYLOAD is the Annex A.1 item 176 obligation and it is DISCHARGED, not defaulted: docs/CONFORMANCE.md 7 DOC-A.1-176 publishes payload ZERO for the quiet form (binary32 0x7FC00000, binary64 0x7FF8000000000000, sign bit per the SIGN phrase), and IeeeSpecials is both the documented table and the emitted one. Every NaN is written as a BIT PATTERN through BitConverter rather than as a CLR constant, because double.NaN is 0xFFF8000000000000 (sign bit SET) and GR34's positive default would otherwise depend on how a constant negation folds. Observable witness: a quiet NaN is unequal to ITSELF.
